doc.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Thanks, cracked bass and goodbyes
summary: Closing thanks; Lesberg has found a crack in his bass that an engineer helped repair before the evening concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Anyhow, thanks for giving me the chance to talk about it. I enjoy talking about it.
Looking forward to hearing some more music tonight. And I hope that bass behaves for you this evening.

I’ve been down there for two hours. I finally found, there’s a crack in it. So fortunately one of the engineers was very kind. I ran into him on the street and boy he just saved me, he spent an hour with me.
Well on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank you for joining us. I look forward to your playing tonight.
I enjoyed talking to you. Okay. All the best.
